Terms used across the collective. Terms specific to the Company Brain tools are on [[Company Brain/Glossary]].

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Term
! Meaning
|-
| '''Clean room'''
| Building compatible software only from public information, with the people who write the spec kept apart from the people who write the code
|-
| '''Firewall'''
| The separation between spec writers and builders
|-
| '''Drop-in'''
| Works with existing client code or SDKs without changes
|-
| '''Compatibility laboratory'''
| A test setup that runs the vendors’ own public client SDKs against our server
|-
| '''Provenance'''
| The recorded source of each fixture, reference or spec statement
|-
| '''Per-seat tax'''
| Pricing that charges for each user rather than for the infrastructure used
|-
| '''Occupied / Proposed'''
| Status of a target category on the occupation map: a project exists, or it has been suggested (see [[Projects]])
|-
| '''Release candidate (RC)'''
| A build offered for wide testing before a final release, for example ZeroAuthy v1.0.0-rc.1
|-
| '''OpenID Certified'''
| Certification by the OpenID Foundation that an implementation passes the conformance suite for given profiles
|-
| '''Target'''
| A SaaS category or product we propose to replace
|}
